title: What It Actually Looks Like to Hold a High Standard and Still Be Easy to Be Around
caption:
Some guys get serious about their faith and become impossible to be around. Every meal is a lecture. Every choice someone else makes gets a sigh.

That's not holiness. That's the Pharisee move: a high bar pointed at everyone but yourself.

The godly man flips it. Hard on his own sin, gentle with yours. He deals with his own log first, skips the commentary, laughs at himself, and becomes the guy a struggling brother actually calls.

"First take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take the speck out of your brother's eye." Matthew 7:5

Save this. Send it to the brother who makes a high bar look like grace.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #humility #brotherhood
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
